title: Segmentation-aware eval suites for Dedicated & Private customers
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers deploying Redwood Dedicated or Private want per-customer eval suites that run without exporting sensitive data off their VPC or corporate network, plus tight controls so config/model changes never regress customer-specific quality. Scope: design and deliver a first-class experience that lets account admins and platform engineers configure evaluation suites scoped to their tenant, run them in isolation (on dedicated infra or on-prem eval runners), and tie results into Console gating/alerts. Must include data-handling guardrails (redaction/hashing/k-anonymization), RBAC controls, and auditable evaluation logs. Not in scope: full eval authoring UI (we will wire to the existing eval DSL initially).
acceptance_criteria: Customers can register a tenant-specific eval suite that references private prompt/testcases without leaving the customer VPC
Eval runs can be executed on Dedicated clusters or private on-prem eval runners with zero-copy data access or approved local storage
Results are available in the Console with per-tenant access controls and an audit trail that shows model/config version, kernel/quantization profile, and who triggered the run
Automated regression detection that compares baseline metrics and raises alerts when degradation exceeds configurable thresholds
API hooks for CI/CD to gate model/config rollouts based on customer eval pass/fail
Privacy modes: (a) redaction only, (b) hashing with deterministic salt, (c) local differential privacy simulated for metric aggregation
Security review sign-off completed and sample customers (2) onboarded for pilot
